precisionNote: Same convention as evm-fixtures.json: FullPrecision fields computed directly from raw BAC/PV/EV/AC with .NET System.Decimal (28-29 significant digits); Rounded2dp fields are the money-precision values stated verbatim in the source. Rounding rule: half-away-from-zero at the response boundary only (MidpointRounding.AwayFromZero) - .NET's Math.Round defaults to banker's rounding and MUST NOT be used unqualified (evm-formulas.md line 104-108).

unifiedPerformanceFactorForm.note: Every PF-based variant is the same formula with a different Performance Factor PF - implement one function, not five (line 55-58).

variants.when: Current cost performance is typical and will continue; default for unit-rate/repetitive construction work.
The overrun/underrun was a one-off with a documented root cause; remaining work runs at the planned rate.
Schedule slippage is itself driving cost; most conservative when CPI<1 and SPI<1.
A fresh bottom-up re-estimate of remaining work exists; overrides all indices; requires Project.EacManualEtc >= 0.
Contract- or QS-mandated factor (e.g. lender's agreed 1.15); PF_c must be > 0, rejected at validation otherwise.

orderingAssertions.condition: CPI>1 and SPI>1 (mirror of Fixture A - ordering reverses)

edgeCaseRules.condition: BAC - EV = 0 (work complete, or zero-budget scope)
edgeCaseRules.behaviour: Short-circuit before dividing: ETC = 0.00, EAC = AC for every variant. Never evaluate PF.

edgeCaseRules.condition: EV = 0 and AC = 0 and PV = 0 (not started)
edgeCaseRules.behaviour: All variants -> null, reason NotStarted. Render em-dash.

edgeCaseRules.condition: AC = 0 and EV > 0 (actuals not yet posted)
edgeCaseRules.behaviour: CPI undefined -> CpiBased, CpiSpiBased, and (by rule) Atypical all -> null, reason NoActualCost, plus a data-quality warning. Atypical is arithmetically computable (= BAC-EV) but excludes the cost of work already done, so it is suppressed on purpose. BottomUpEtc remains valid if ETC_manual is supplied.

edgeCaseRules.condition: PV = 0 and EV > 0 (no baseline / unbaselined scope)
edgeCaseRules.behaviour: SPI undefined -> CpiSpiBased -> null, reason NoPlannedValue. CpiBased, Atypical, BottomUpEtc, CustomPf remain valid.

edgeCaseRules.condition: EV = 0 and AC > 0 (cost burned, nothing earned)
edgeCaseRules.behaviour: CPI = 0 -> CpiBased, CpiSpiBased -> null (division by zero), reason ZeroCpi. Atypical = AC + BAC is valid and is what the dashboard should show.
ETC goes negative. Compute and return as-is, and raise validation warning EarnedValueExceedsBudget. Clamp ProgressPercentage to [0,100] at input instead of masking it here.
edgeCaseRules.gap: No worked numeric example given in source for this condition - only the qualitative rule. Do not fabricate a fixture; obtain concrete numbers from domain-expert before Sprint 7 if a numeric test is required.

edgeCaseRules.behaviour: Reject at validation (FluentValidation), do not compute.
edgeCaseRules.gap: No specific boundary values given in source (e.g. whether PF_c = 0 exactly is covered by '<=' - yes per the stated condition).
